title: 'Father of the iPod' Tony Fadell suggests 3 features Apple could add to the iPhone to fight device addiction (AAPL)
text: 'Father of the iPod' Tony Fadell suggests 3 features Apple could add to the iPhone to fight device addiction (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Apr 16, 2018, 10:11 am 8 pts Technologist Tony Fadell, who founded Nest and worked on the original iPod, is worried about device overuse. In an editorial for Wired UK, he suggested some features Apple could build into future iPhones to fight device addiction. One of his ideas is an iPhone feature that lets people set their own…
